question: Can you bring payroll, timecards and finance data together?
answer: Yes. A Microsoft Fabric lakehouse we built unifies payroll, timecards and finance into one model, so management sees labor cost against finance in one dashboard. [Read the case study](/case-studies/labor-cost-finance-microsoft-fabric/).

question: How do you stop changes from breaking our reports?
answer: Every change is tested and released through automated pipelines across development, test and production, so nothing goes straight to production untested.

question: Which platforms do you use for finance data?
answer: In our finance work, Microsoft Fabric, with Power BI for reporting. We also work with Databricks, and your data stays in your own environment.

question: Where should a finance team start?
answer: With a [Data & AI Readiness Review](/readiness-review/). In about 10 working days you get a written plan, and you decide if we’re the right fit.
